get.definition: to obtain, buy, or manage to have something
to receive or be given something
to arrive at a place or reach a particular point
to begin to be in a particular state

take.definition: to move someone or something from one place to another
to require a particular amount of time
to use a form of transport or consume medicine

make.definition: to produce, prepare, or create something
to cause a person or thing to be in a particular state
to earn money or produce a financial result

set.definition: to decide or establish a limit, time, rule, or goal
to adjust or program a device or control
to put something carefully in a particular position

run.definition: to manage or be responsible for a business, team, or operation

hold.definition: to keep something in your hand, arms, or a fixed position
to organize and have an event, meeting, or election
to have and keep a position, title, record, or belief

turn.definition: to move or rotate in a different direction
to become a particular color, age, or condition
to cause something to become a different state or condition

pass.definition: to succeed in an exam, test, or assessment
to give something to someone who is near you
to move past, or for time to go by

deal.definition: to take action to solve, manage, or respond to a situation
to give cards to players in a card game
to buy and sell a particular type of product

keep.definition: to continue to have something and not give it away or lose it
to remain, or cause someone or something to remain, in a particular state
to continue doing something repeatedly or for a period of time

break.definition: to damage something so that it separates, cracks, or stops working
to fail to obey a rule, law, promise, or agreement
to do better than the previous best result

charge.definition: to ask someone to pay a particular amount for a product or service
to put electrical energy into a battery or device
to officially accuse someone of committing a crime

control.definition: to direct, limit, or regulate how something works or changes
to keep a situation, reaction, or emotion within limits

draw.definition: to make a picture, diagram, or shape with lines
to attract attention, interest, people, or a reaction
to form a conclusion after considering information or evidence

fit.definition: to be the right size or shape for a particular space
to be the correct size and shape for someone to wear
to find enough space or time for something

give.definition: to transfer something to another person
to provide information, permission, advice, help, or another non-physical thing
to cause someone to experience a feeling, problem, or result

go.definition: to move or travel to another place
to leave a place, especially in order to travel somewhere else
to become a particular state, especially one that changes over time
to take part in an activity expressed with an -ing form

grow.definition: to become larger, stronger, older, or greater over time
to produce plants, food, or crops by taking care of them
to develop or increase a business, audience, skill, or other activity

leave.definition: to go away from a place or person
to put something somewhere and go away, intentionally or by mistake
to cause someone or something to remain in a particular state

mean.definition: to have a particular meaning or represent a particular idea
to intend or plan to do something
to have something as a necessary result or consequence

miss.definition: to fail to catch transport or fail to attend an event
to feel sad or notice the absence of a person, place, or thing
to fail to notice, understand, use, or take an opportunity

play.definition: to take part in a sport or game
to perform music using an instrument or recording
to perform or have a particular role in a situation, story, or process

raise.definition: to move something to a higher position
to increase an amount, level, price, or standard
to take care of a child or family while they grow up

save.definition: to keep money, time, or resources so they can be used later
to store digital information so it can be used again
to prevent a person, animal, or thing from being harmed, lost, or destroyed

show.definition: to let someone see something or make something visible
to teach or demonstrate how to do something
to provide evidence, signs, or information that makes something clear

work.definition: to do a job or spend time doing professional tasks
to operate correctly or in the intended way
to produce the result that is needed or be suitable for a person or situation

cover.definition: to place something over a surface, object, or person
to include, discuss, or deal with a subject or area
to provide enough money to pay for a cost or expense
to do another person's work while they are unavailable

present.definition: to formally show, explain, or introduce information, an idea, or a proposal
to formally give someone an award, gift, or document

settle.definition: to end a disagreement, problem, or legal matter by reaching a solution
to make a final choice after considering different possibilities
to begin living in a place and make it your home

treat.definition: to behave toward a person in a particular way
to give medical care for an illness, injury, or condition
to pay for something enjoyable for yourself or another person
